decisive_tests: The report rainfall range is about five times the GPM and CHIRPS event maxima used in the package summary.
The snow gradient is much larger than the low-point snow amount: 48.0x from high mountain to La Crescenta and 316.7x from high mountain to the 90 m point.

decision_rule.summary: The final label must be driven by the near-fivefold report-to-grid rainfall gaps and the large elevation snow ratios; low-point wind and annual embedding change are secondary numeric checks.

criteria.name: Source-role mapping
criteria.description: Uses the point weather file, report HTML, GPM, CHIRPS, and annual embedding-change product for their intended numeric roles.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for using most source roles correctly while confusing one gridded or embedding product.

criteria.name: Low-point cold and wind ledger
criteria.description: Computes the low-point snowfall, cold-hour count, maximum gust, gust-hour count, and gust-energy proxy correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for small rounding errors or for getting only the temperature or wind half of the ledger correct.

criteria.name: Report snow and rain conversions
criteria.description: Extracts and converts the report snow and rain anchors, including the high-mountain snow and local rainfall range.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for correct extraction but one unit conversion or ratio error.

criteria.name: Grid-report gap ratios
criteria.description: Compares report rainfall with GPM and CHIRPS maxima and reports the near-fivefold gap ratios.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for identifying the gap direction but missing one exact ratio.

criteria.name: Embedding-change separation
criteria.description: Uses the annual embedding mean, maximum, and max-to-mean ratio as a separate landscape-change check, not as event-window precipitation.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for computing the values but blending them with the precipitation diagnosis.

criteria.name: Final compact diagnosis
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact answer with a label equivalent to report_grid_gap_with_elevation_snow_gradient.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for a compatible label with incomplete but mostly correct numeric support.

provenance.notes: Values are rebuilt from local package files using unit conversion, hourly counts, and ratio checks.
